response.rationale: Reach z-score of 4.586 is a large, highly significant deviation, well beyond noise thresholds. CPM is essentially flat (z=0.203) and OSA is unchanged (z=0.0), indicating the reach surge occurred at stable prices — consistent with a genuine demand-side or inventory-availability shift rather than a price/competition cost shock. The own-action confound flag is False, so this is unlikely to be the harness's own prior bid/budget change landing in the data. The decoupled pattern (big reach move, no price move) supports a real market surge in available reach.
